The '''New Canistel system''' was a part of the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the inconsequential [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Canistel]], which was home to the [[senoti]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]], a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] whose sap was known for its medicinal properties.<ref name="G9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The New Canistel [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-7.<ref name="TEA" />
